c.tagline: Switzerland's Italian soul — a palm-lined lake framed by alpine peaks.

taxi.fareNote: Swiss taxis are expensive and metered; app-based ride-hailing (Uber) has only very limited coverage in Ticino, so licensed taxi ranks and phone bookings are the norm.

emergency.note: 112 is the pan-European emergency number; Switzerland also uses 117 for police, 144 for ambulance, and 118 for fire.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_desc: Lugano's pedestrian old town around Piazza della Riforma, with arcaded Italianate streets, the lakefront promenade, and the LAC arts centre; the walkable heart for first-timers.
A lakeside district at the foot of Monte San Salvatore, with hotels, the funicular base, and a lido; good for lake views and easy access to the peak.
A green, residential quarter by Parco Ciani and the Monte Brè funicular base, near the lake and the cantonal art museum; leafy and relaxed.
A lively student district around the Università della Svizzera italiana, with everyday shops, cafes, and cheaper eats; central and unpretentious.
A quiet residential neighbourhood by the railway station, handy for trains and a short walk downhill to the centre; calm and convenient.

water.note: Swiss tap water is excellent everywhere, including public fountains.

transit.hours: TPL city buses run from roughly 6:00 AM to around midnight; the Monte San Salvatore and Monte Brè funiculars run daytime hours (seasonal), and lake boats operate mainly March to October.
transit.note: Trasporti Pubblici Luganesi (TPL) runs the city buses; two funiculars climb Monte San Salvatore and Monte Brè, and Società Navigazione del Lago di Lugano runs scenic boats across the lake. The compact centre is best explored on foot.
transit.pay: Buses use the regional Arcobaleno tariff — buy a ticket from stop machines, the app, or the driver and hold it for the journey; funiculars and boats are ticketed separately.

air: Lugano Airport (Agno, LUG) — small, very limited flights
Milan Malpensa (MXP) ~75 km — main international gateway
ferry: Lake Lugano boats (SNL) to Gandria, Morcote, Melide and Campione d'Italia
train: Lugano station (SBB/FFS) on the Gotthard line — direct trains to Zurich, Milan and Bellinzona

airport.name: Milan Malpensa (MXP) — main international gateway; Lugano-Agno (LUG) is small with very limited flights

tip.r: Service is included by law; rounding up or leaving 5-10% for good service is appreciated but not expected.
